question: Sample-size learning curves and smaller CNN vs original CNN and RF under matched participant plans.
data: Same immutable OlderAdults44 target.npz:44people220trials, Vicon sagittal projection, actual SPPB5..12, no new people.
full_people: 35 or36 per outer fold; inner optimizer groups23 or24 in full condition; small sets have smaller inner train groups.
subset_policy: Nested prefixes of deterministic proportional score-band ordering using outer-training labels only. No outer-test labels used. Separate draw variance, do not average draws into an unfair larger ensemble.

models.CNN: Same six conv blocks/kernel8/pool2,2,3/hidden10. Change channels only. Scratch only. AdamW lr.001 wd.001 dropout.5 weighted normalized MSE,batch32,max80,patience12. Choose median best inner epoch, refit subset.
models.RF: Same coordinate temporal36features;128trees;leaf2or5 chosen within each subset inner3 folds;train-only weighted scaler, equal person weights; same3seeds.

bn_policy.transfer: Only learned backbone weights/affine parameters are retained; old running statistics reset before target fitting.
bn_policy.optimization: Regular training-mode mini-batch BN and dropout; no validation/test data in optimization.
bn_policy.inference_statistics: After every epoch before validation, disable dropout and recompute all BN buffers in one full training-only no-gradient pass with momentum1. Each layer observes current training-batch activations. Save the calibrated checkpoint.
bn_policy.refit: After the fixed selected epochs, perform the identical training-only calibration before checkpointing and inference.
bn_policy.source_pretrain: Retrain HealthGait source selection/refit under the identical policy. GDI source weights remain the fixed prior fold0 weights.
bn_policy.scope: Source-pretraining selection and target selection are both BN-corrected, so compare corrected complete pipelines rather than attributing every change solely to target calibration.
bn_policy.verify: Independent CPU recomputation of every saved BN buffer, training IDs/window-index hash, epoch choice and prediction replay; test batch-size invariance and no parameter updates during calibration.

primary: Mean across draw-specific MAE of the three-seed ensemble; also report each seed/draw,RMSE,within1,within2,rounded exact,score-band errors and conditional paired person intervals. Full condition uses one identical whole subset, not three duplicate runs.
controls: Constant train-person mean/median per subset. Check full CNN32/RF against prior verified predictions. No output clipping, no outer-label selection.
verification: SHA256 archive/model/input/plan, independently expected splits, train-only label/scaler/BN stats, all saved CNN/RF prediction replay, nested epoch/leaf selection, count checks; actual CUDA pilot before main.
scope: Exploratory repeatedly inspected44-person development CV. Learning curves cannot guarantee benefit at hundreds of people or RGB/clinical generalization. No further automatic optimization round authorized.
